malory-1-1.title: The silence of Gildas
malory-1-1.why: Malory begins where the confidence has become total: not with a question about whether there was an Arthur, but with his father's name.

malory-1-1.title: Vortigern's tower and the two dragons
malory-1-1.why: Malory's Merlin walks on stage with no introduction at all, which is itself worth noticing.

malory-1-19.title: The twelve battles

malory-1-19.title: The prophecies of Merlin
malory-1-19.why: Malory's Merlin tells Arthur to his face that he has begotten the child who will destroy him and all the knights of his realm.

malory-1-19.title: The children of May Day
malory-1-19.why: Merlin tells Arthur what he has begotten.

malory-1-6.why: Arthur pulls it out again and again while the barons refuse to accept him.
